messages.subject: Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) message encountered
parts:
Hello I'm trying to create a model for Antenatal care attendance and I got this error. I'm still new to INLA. I need help thanks.


require(INLA)
require(splancs)
require(sp)
require(fields)
require(maptools)
require(lattice)
require(abind)


N <- readShapePoly(paste("ANC DATA/N-level_1",sep=""))
> N.adj <- paste("ANC DATA/N.graph",sep="")

> formulaANC <- ANC~ 1 + resided + Educ + f(state, model = "iid") + f(state,model="bym",graph=N.adj, constr=TRUE)

> ModelANC <- inla(formulaANC,family="poisson",data=data,
+                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
+                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))

Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.read.graph.ascii.internal(..., size.only = size.only) :
  NAs introduced by coercion
